paragraphs: R. Yehudah bar Shila. R. Assi said, “Once, etc.,” and they asked R. Yochanan: Shabbat 139a, near the end, 142b. There, 126a, near the end: Rav Yehudah bar Shilat said: R. Assi said: R. Yochanan said. Heilprin proposes reading bar Shila and cites Rif. [The checked Rif gives bar Shila and R. Assi, and also retains R. Yochanan.] There, beginning of 126b: R. Yehudah bar Shila said: R. Assi said: R. Yochanan said. There, 44a, 127a; Yevamot 82b. [The checked Yevamot passage transmits from R. Assi in R. Yochanan’s name.] Niddah 63a has Rav Ashi in R. Elazar’s name. Heilprin proposes “R. Assi said: R. Elazar said.”
